entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MediaPicker.CapturePhotoAsync uses the camera Intent, so requiring android.permission.CAMERA is unnecessary #32431
  • [iOS 26] Navigation hangs after rapidly open and closing new page using Navigation.PushAsync #32425
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] issue with nested markups #32424
    .NET 10.0 SR1
  • [Android] WebView Height Continuously Increases on Pixel 5, API 33 #32422
  • [iOS, Mac Catalyst] Shell Flyout and Content Do Not Fully Support RightToLeft (RTL) #32419
    Backlog
  • DisplayPrompt not working and not even showing... #32418
  • Shell ItemTemplate and MenuItemTemplate are not applied dynamically at runtime #32417
    Backlog
  • [Android, Windows] Shell.FlyoutVerticalScrollMode="Disabled" does not disable scrolling #32416
    Backlog
  • Android Splash screen not hide when navigation #32415
  • I4_ Selection - Selected items are not highlighted in orange #32414

Closed

  • [.NET 10] CLI - Creating new MAUI with Sample using CLI fails to restore with NU1107 error #32198
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • PublishTrimmed=true on iOS and MacCatalyst release builds crashes on app startup #32413
  • Opting in the source generation in Maui .net 10 generates lots of errors #32398
